items.name: Överflöd Zenith
items.howToGet: Buy it from the dealer site once you have a garage, or look for one parked outside the Ocean Beach hotels at night.
items.note: The one to chase for pure pace. Expensive, and twitchy until you learn it.

items.name: Pfister Astron S
items.howToGet: Common in the richer parts of Vice City. Easy to find from the first hour.
items.note: The best daily driver early on: fast enough, forgiving, and easy to find.

items.name: Western Rampart
items.howToGet: Parked outside bars along the coast road.
items.note: Best tool for losing a wanted level in the city. Just don't kiss a wall.

items.name: Canis Everglade
items.howToGet: Spawns on the dirt roads around Grassrivers.
items.note: Slow on tarmac, unstoppable in Grassrivers. Keep one for the wild regions.
